claims.claim_text: Large 2021 is the target's central geometric seed for the non-framed exact-Lagrangian case because the paper explicitly says that exact Lagrangian Floer data determines a flow category F_LK.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: It was shown by [Lar21] that this data ... determines a flow category F_LK whose objects are Hamiltonian chords, and whose morphism spaces are spaces of broken Floer strips with boundary on L and K.

claims.claim_text: The motivating obstruction inherited from the exact-Lagrangian example is that the Lagrangian difference map controls tangential structure and can obstruct framing.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: The tangential structure of F_LK is controlled ... by the Lagrangian difference map P_X(L, K) -> U/O. The non-triviality of this map presents potential obstructions to framing F_LK.

claims.claim_text: Abouzaid-Blumberg 2024 supplies the framed-flow-category baseline and categorical machinery that the target generalizes beyond the framed setting.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Abouzaid-Blumberg show that framed flow categories can be arranged into a stable infinity-category, and show that this is a model for the infinity-category of spectra.

claims.claim_text: The target identifies modules over Thom spectra, spectral local systems, and filtered spectral diagrams as cases of a single twisted-presheaf formalism.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: We have seen that various flavors of Floer homotopy types are expected to define objects in the stable infinity-categories Mod_MG, Sp^X, and Fun(A^op, Sp) respectively. These admit a common generalization: they are all infinity-categories of twisted presheaves.

claims.claim_text: Douglas 2005 is a supporting genealogy seed because the target states that it provided a framework for twisted stable homotopy theory.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: A framework for twisted stable homotopy theory was provided by Douglas in his PhD thesis [Dou05].

claims.claim_text: Furuta 2002 is a tempting origin candidate for the non-framed agenda, but under this run it cannot be promoted beyond a negative ancestor because the target itself hedges the claim and the cited source was not directly read.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: That some version of twisted stable homotopy theory is needed ... was perhaps first pointed out by Furuta in the unpublished document [Fur02].

claims.claim_text: Porcelli-Smith 2024 is a supporting seed because the target uses tangential pairs from that work to explain how different orientation data can be pushed through the same Floer flow category.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: If we can factor ... the Lagrangian difference map through the homotopy pullback Theta x_Phi Theta -> U/O. We can therefore push forward the natural P_X(L, K)-structure on the Floer flow category to obtain a Theta x_Phi Theta-structure.

claims.claim_text: The outward reinforcement check supports the PS24 edge: its abstract explicitly presents graded tangential pairs as the mechanism for extending spectral Floer theory beyond the stably framed case.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: We define a spectral Donaldson-Fukaya category for any graded tangential pair Theta -> Phi ... The flexibility to tune the choice of Theta and Phi increases the range of cases in which one can kill the obstructions.

claims.claim_text: The paper's novelty claim is that the stable category of mu-structured flow categories is naturally equivalent to the stable category of mu-twisted presheaves.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: There is a natural equivalence of functors Cat_{infinity/(U/O)} -> Pr^L_{St,omega}, Flow^{(-)} ≃ TwShv^{(-)}.

claims.claim_text: Transferred input dominates the setup: framed-flow machinery from AB24, exact-Lagrangian flow categories from Lar21, twisted stable homotopy from Dou05, and tangential-structure tuning from PS24; the paper's novelty is the mu-structured synthesis and the equivalence theorem linking flow categories to twisted presheaves.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: Abouzaid-Blumberg show ... model for spectra. ... It was shown by [Lar21] ... determines a flow category F_LK. ... A framework for twisted stable homotopy theory was provided by Douglas ... We can therefore push forward the natural P_X(L, K)-structure ... The main result ... Flow^{(-)} ≃ TwShv^{(-)}.

claims.claim_text: A bounded blind reconstruction is that the paper is driven by the need to keep non-framed Floer flow categories while simultaneously encoding orientation, local-system, and filtration data in one formalism whose stable output matches the twisted-presheaf category predicted by those inputs.
claims.quotation_or_excerpt: The non-triviality of this map presents potential obstructions to framing ... various flavors ... Mod_MG, Sp^X, and Fun(A^op, Sp) ... are all infinity-categories of twisted presheaves ... Flow^{(-)} ≃ TwShv^{(-)}.
